name: Random tweaks
description: Original random tweak recipe with a 20-candidate limit.

name: Largest enumerated tweaks
description: Last enumerated tweak, with no candidate limit; tends toward denser open space in prior small-board experiments.

name: First enumerated tweaks
description: Opposite end of the tweak enumeration from the large-tweak recipe.

name: Early path segments
description: Length-2 preference applied to earlier path segments.

name: Late path segments
description: The same tweak preference applied to later path segments.

name: Longest segments first
description: Prioritizes long straight path segments for reshaping.

name: Late pivot preference
description: Maximizes Len1 (the pivot offset), within a 20-candidate limit; this does not mean shortest tweaks.

name: One pass, endpoints kept
description: One segment-picker pass and no endpoint trimming; contrasts with exhaustive multi-pass recipes.
